context.purpose: Evaluate a Fisher-guided authentication-feature selection rule for blind fragile image authentication.
context.dataPolicy: Dataset pixels and machine-local roots remain outside version control; only manifests, summaries and provenance-safe aggregate results are candidates for promotion.

split.splitPolicy: Use the manifest row order within each subcorpus: calibration rows first, evaluation rows next.

primaryAnalysis.primaryMetric: block-level F1 under each declared attack
supportivePattern: Fisher mean attack F1 exceeds fixed, random and smallest on most declared attacks.
Fisher clean PSNR remains comparable to fixed and random.
Identity-cost results are interpreted with their clean-PSNR cost.
uncertainty: favorable, unfavorable and tied image-pair counts
